# lightdash_project (Resource)

Manages a Lightdash project whose dbt connection type is `none`. This resource does not set warehouse credentials and does not support other dbt connection types.

The Lightdash API has no endpoint that deletes a project. When `deletion_protection` is `false`, `terraform destroy` removes the project from Terraform state and returns a warning that names the project. The project remains in Lightdash and must be deleted in the UI. When `deletion_protection` is `true`, destroy returns an error and the project stays in state. Imported projects default to `deletion_protection = true`.

To drop a project from state without running destroy, replace the resource with a `removed` block and set `lifecycle { destroy = false }`. The `removed` block requires Terraform 1.7 or later.

Changing `name`, `type`, or `dbt_version` replaces the Terraform resource. The previous Lightdash project is left in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lightdash_project" "example" {
  name                = "example-project"
  type                = "DEFAULT"
  dbt_version         = "latest"
  deletion_protection = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dbt_version` (String) The dbt version sent to Lightdash unchanged. Lightdash rejects a version it does not support. Changing it replaces the Terraform resource. The dbt connection is always type `none`.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) When set to `true`, Terraform will not remove the project from state. Imported projects default to `true`. Destroy never deletes the project in Lightdash.
- `name` (String) The project name. Changing it replaces the Terraform resource. The previous Lightdash project is left in place.
- `type` (String) The project type. One of `DEFAULT`, `PREVIEW`, or `TRAINING`. Changing it replaces the Terraform resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The project UUID. Import an existing project with this value.
- `project_uuid` (String) The UUID of the Lightdash project.
- `slug` (String) The URL slug of the project.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Projects are imported by project UUID.
# Imported projects start with deletion_protection = true.
terraform import lightdash_project.example "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
```
